description: Hodge Close Quarry, located near Coniston in the Lake District, is a former slate quarry renowned for its impressive rock formations and deep, water-filled pits. The area offers a variety of walking routes, with one popular option being a 2.9-mile loop trail that passes through both Hodge Close Quarry and the nearby Cathedral Cavern. This moderately challenging route typically takes around 1 hour and 26 minutes to complete. The cavern is accessible via a short tunnel, and inside, natural light filters through openings, creating a cathedral-like atmosphere. Exploring the cavern adds an adventurous element to the walk. Throughout the hike, you'll be treated to views of the surrounding fells and valleys, with the Langdale Pikes visible in the distance. The combination of industrial heritage and natural beauty makes this walk a memorable experience. Please note that the single-lane road leading to the car park is narrow, and the parking area itself is small, which can make access challenging during peak times.
